title: Mixer cover
text: Mixer cover. I have a kitchenaid that is about 15 years old... it is the kind that is larger, and bends up and back.  It fit perfectly under this cover.  After all these years and I glad to "retire" the kitchen towel I had draped over it.  It is a black, quilted, nylon type material.  There are two side pockets on one side.  My mixer is a sparkle white - it was an anniversary edition way back then and I think the black is nice.  I would wash delicately and hand dry.  I will update if any new info would be useful.
